import os
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e9266c08.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The 2-colored full row/column is the barrier.
    barrier = None
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x == 2 for x in grid[r]):
            barrier = ("h", r)
            break
    if barrier is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)):
                barrier = ("v", c)
                break
    obj = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c,_ in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg
    orient, pos = barrier
    if orient == "v":
        cmin, cmax = min(c for r,c,v in obj), max(c for r,c,v in obj)
        if cmax < pos:
            dc = pos - 1 - cmax
            left, right = cmin + dc, cmax + dc
            marker = left - 1
        else:
            dc = pos + 1 - cmin
            left, right = cmin + dc, cmax + dc
            marker = right + 1
        for r,c,v in obj:
            out[r][c+dc] = v
        for r in range(h):
            if 0 <= marker < w: out[r][marker] = 8
    else:
        rmin, rmax = min(r for r,c,v in obj), max(r for r,c,v in obj)
        if rmax < pos:
            dr = pos - 1 - rmax
            top, bottom = rmin + dr, rmax + dr
            marker = top - 1
        else:
            dr = pos + 1 - rmin
            top, bottom = rmin + dr, rmax + dr
            marker = bottom + 1
        for r,c,v in obj:
            out[r+dr][c] = v
        for c in range(w):
            if 0 <= marker < h: out[marker][c] = 8
    return out
'''
